prompts.name: bunny
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One isolated original sticker for Chloe's very simple spring coloring page for a young child: a seated friendly spring bunny, two long ears with single large inner-ear regions, round head, large simple body, two big feet and a little round tail. Tiny dot eyes and one simple smile. No fur lines, whiskers, clothing, paws with toes or patterns. Flat friendly rounded hand-drawn illustration, entire object visible with margin. Very few BIG closed coloring regions, intentionally much simpler than typical coloring books. Bold pure black outlines about 15 pixels at 1024px source height, opaque plain white interior, genuine transparent exterior. NO gray, shading, shadows, hatching, text, gradients or detailed textures. No ground, background scene or other objects. Keep all colorable regions broad and easy to click with a paint bucket.
